    a = list(map(int, data[1:]))
    
    inc_stack = []
    dec_stack = []
    
    for num in a:
        while inc_stack and inc_stack[-1] >= num:
            inc_stack.pop()
        while dec_stack and dec_stack[-1] <= num:
            dec_stack.pop()
        
        if inc_stack and inc_stack[-1] == num:
            print("NO")
            return
        if dec_stack and dec_stack[-1] == num:
            print("NO")
            return
        
        inc_stack.append(num)
        dec_stack.append(num)
    
    inc_result = sorted(inc_stack)
    dec_result = sorted(dec_stack, reverse=True)
    
    if len(inc_result) + len(dec_result) != n:
        print("NO")

    print("YES")
    print(len(inc_result))
    print(" ".join(map(str, inc_result)))

    print(" ".join(map(str, dec_result)))
